name: onenote-mcp
description: Read and write local Microsoft OneNote notebooks, both from local backups and live via the running OneNote app. No account, API key, or Azure setup needed.
long_description:
Gives Claude direct access to local Microsoft OneNote notebooks. Reads from OneNote's local backup snapshots for quick browsing and search, and drives the running OneNote desktop app via its COM API for always-current reads plus writing: creating sections and pages, and appending content.

Originally created by mhzarem (https://github.com/mhzarem/onenote-mcp) under the MIT license. This is a modified, substantially extended derivative by Rail1337 -- not the original author -- adding live page/section reading, live section creation, a page-title escaping fix, and language-independent backup detection. Stays open source under the same MIT license.
